summary: Iter41 tested new Syarat (6) + Kelengkapan Berkas (11) landing sections + Super Admin CMS edit/add flow. Backend pytest 5/5 passed in /app/backend/tests/test_site_content_syarat.py: (1) public GET /api/site/content returns eligibility_requirements length 6 and required_documents length 11 with 'Surat Permohonan' and 'Pakta Integritas' present; (2) PUT /api/site/content is 401/403 unauthenticated, 403 for student, 403 for admin (RBAC), 200 for super_admin; (3) super_admin edited first eligibility item, appended one syarat and one berkas — response reflects 7/12 and public GET returns same; (4) restore PUT returns lists back to 6/11 with original first eligibility text. Frontend Playwright on preview URL: Landing #persyaratan renders <div data-testid=eligibility-requirements> with 6 CheckCircle rows and <div data-testid=required-documents> with 11 rows including 'Surat Permohonan' and 'Pakta Integritas'; no horizontal overflow at 1920x1080 desktop or 390x844 mobile (scrollWidth == clientWidth). Super Admin login → Kelola Website → site-tab-persyaratan and site-tab-berkas tabs present; used data-testid=eligibility-requirement-0/add-eligibility-requirement/eligibility-requirement-6 and required-document-0/add-required-document/required-document-11 to edit+add+save each list via 'Simpan Perubahan' toast confirmation ('Konten website diperbarui.'). Public /api/site/content reflected 7/12 with TEST_iter41 markers, then full restore via authenticated PUT returned 6/11 with original 'Warga DKI Jakarta...' first eligibility item. Final GET confirms original data intact (elig=6, docs=11, last doc = 'Pakta Integritas ...').
critical_code_review_comments: server.py GET /api/site/content auto-inserts DEFAULT_SITE_CONTENT into DB on first miss AND backfills missing eligibility_requirements/required_documents on subsequent reads — good migration path, and matches the review request expectation.

PUT /api/site/content applies a plain $set of whatever keys the client sends. This is fine for the two new list keys, but note: a super_admin can wipe eligibility_requirements to [] with a single PUT — consider validating that these arrays remain non-empty or at least log audit events for CMS mutations.

SiteManager.jsx StringListEditor delete button has no data-testid (only add and per-index input do). Not required by spec but adding del-eligibility-requirement-<idx> / del-required-document-<idx> would parallel ArrayEditor's del-<testid>-<idx> convention for future automated regression.
Landing.jsx RequirementList <section> lacks role/aria-label; screen readers will announce the surrounding page heading but not the inner list purpose.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (public landing + CMS edit/add/save + restore all verified end-to-end)

rca of the issue: No bugs found. Feature works as specified: two separate lists rendered on Landing #persyaratan (6 eligibility + 11 documents, with Surat Permohonan and Pakta Integritas present), Super Admin can edit/add via Kelola Website tabs Syarat Pendaftar & Kelengkapan Berkas, PUT /api/site/content correctly restricted to super_admin (student/admin → 403, unauth → 401/403), and landing reflects saved content immediately after save.
